verdict.rationale: 1Password stores one-time passwords in its vault (docs-20), and those codes are reachable from more than one device, including Apple Watch and the browser extension (docs-19, docs-21). Community comments implying cloud-only storage (comm-8) suggest the tokens are not tied to a single phone, and export is documented as a backup option (docs-15). None of this describes an actual recovery path for signing in on a new device after losing a phone. missing for 10: documented new-device sign-in and account recovery flow (e.g., recovery codes or an Emergency Kit), explicit documentation of cross-device vault sync, independent or hands-on confirmation of restoring OTPs after losing a device.
